notes_sections.heading: Expired
items: Senior DevOps & Platform Engineer — Incorporan: no longer accepting candidates. Confirmed by Marc September 16, 2026; removed from the actionable table.
Site Reliability Engineer 100% Remote — Apetan Consulting: Dice explicitly says the job is no longer available. Confirmed September 16, 2026; excluded from eligible-current totals.

notes_sections.heading: Run notes
items: All six default titles were searched. Boundary: first search-results page and up to eight plausible results per query, supplemented by direct Dice posting discovery.
“Able to Sponsor” roles require recruiter confirmation that TN support is real and that remote work can be performed from Canada.
No employer-site recovery was needed and no exact repository pipeline match was confirmed.
Dice's “Able to Sponsor” label does not override location, clearance, or authorization text inside a posting.

notes_sections.heading: September 18 refresh delta
items: Cloud & Application Platform Engineer — Quantum Technologies: new eight-month W-2 remote contract at $80–$90/hour. Strong cloud migration, OpenShift, automation, certificate, access and platform-services scope; confirm TN support and Canada-based remote eligibility.

Forward-Deployed Engineer with Generative AI — Key Business Solutions: new six-month remote C2C/W-2/independent contract. Azure and delivery overlap, but deep production RAG/LLM evaluation and full-stack AI engineering are the largest gaps; confirm TN/Canada eligibility.
TechniPros DevSecOps Engineer: new sponsor-marked result, but the detail page says on-site in specified US cities and W-2 only, so it is ineligible.

Previously reported leads no longer surfaced inside the seven-day filtered boundary; they remain preserved below with their last confirmed status rather than being declared expired without direct evidence.
